question: By which seed elements is the kāma-seed enclosed in this formulation?
premises: The kāma-seed is enclosed by kāma.
The kāma-seed is also enclosed by māyā.
inference: The kāma-seed is enclosed by both kāma and māyā.
uncertainties: Kāma and māyā may refer to specific bīja syllables rather than abstract principles.
plain_english: The kāma-seed is enclosed by kāma and by māyā.
